ranked_root_causes.cause: animal completion conflates owned with physically live
ranked_root_causes.evidence: shed and unit-inventory animals are added to live animals before target scoring; buying cows therefore closes the controller deficit before placement

ranked_root_causes.cause: PLANNED is treated as reselectable progress and urgency can starve other physical deficits
ranked_root_causes.evidence: no active production target exists; urgency contributes 4 while bounded deficit plus age contributes at most 3

ranked_root_causes.cause: no reserve-aware admission across workforce and production purchases
ranked_root_causes.evidence: worst spends from 826 to 24 at step 121 and to 4 at step 123; median and worst list fixed-price purchases up to 11804 and 8424 respectively

ranked_root_causes.cause: inventory blockage only delays the target and does not invoke available inventory recovery
ranked_root_causes.evidence: land is inventory-blocked 97 and 98 times; worst never expands beyond one quadrant

ranked_root_causes.cause: late liquidation exposes stranded capital rather than repairing it
ranked_root_causes.evidence: worst terminal sale liquidates wheat but leaves two cows and one sheep in shed

controller_changes: separate live animal counts from total owned counts; preserve irreversible quota floors on total owned but score execution completion on live counts
use lexicographic scheduling: inventory recovery and urgent maintenance, then completion of stranded unit work, then capital expansion, then new growth
retain one active production key for a bounded dwell until physical progress or explicit block; PLANNED alone must not release it, then round-robin among physically deficient targets
add a hard oldest-deficit fairness override so urgency cannot starve a physical deficit beyond 24 turns
admit fixed-price buys and workforce only while preserving a 400-money reserve; cap animal target growth by affordable quantity
forbid land expansion while any urgent or stranded unit state exists or cash is below the reserve plus land cost
after KG-EXEC-INVENTORY, prepend existing RECOVERY:INVENTORY and suppress competing unit-heavy work until inventories clear

must_pass_before_full_old80: 719 completed transitions and final state step 719 in both cases
zero post-handoff normalization, sanitization, and fallback
after any fixed-price purchase from step 120 onward, money remains at least 400
an animal bought into shed is either live or under RECOVERY within 24 turns
urgent maintenance and stranded unit inventory preempt land expansion
no physical quota deficit remains unselected for more than 48 turns
worst representative reaches at least two land quadrants by step 192
terminal shed has no COW or SHEEP
candidate money is at least half of paired V59: 53036.5 on episode 99614514 and 53533.0 on episode 99589578
oracle_screen_stop_gate.stop_condition: If either case fails any hard condition, do not run full old80, fresh, third, future, or upload. Diagnose the failed condition first.

limitations: Recorded opponent action tapes become strategically stale after candidate-state divergence; same-case money is an oracle screen, not live-policy proof.
Listed fixed purchase cost is an upper bound because the legalizer may retain a partially fillable listed quantity.
PLANNED without same-step composition progress can include useful movement; it is supporting churn evidence, not a standalone failure label.
No fresh, third, future, or hidden holdout was inspected.
